name: neon-district
description: PS2-style free-roam city arcade driving game: traffic, crimes and cops. Three.js + Rapier + TypeScript.

scripts.deploy: REMOTE=$(git config --get remote.origin.url) && npm run build && touch dist/.nojekyll && rm -rf dist/.git && git -C dist init -b gh-pages && git -C dist add -A && git -C dist commit -m 'Deploy to GitHub Pages' && git -C dist push -f "$REMOTE" gh-pages:gh-pages && rm -rf dist/.git
